Visa regime
Nationals of the Republic of Lithuania may enter, cross the territory and stay in Montenegro up to 90 days without visa, with valid travel document.
Nationals of the Republic of Lithuania may enter, cross the territory and stay in Montenegro up to 30 days without visa, with valid Identity Card isued by relevant authority of the Republic of Lithuania.
Diplomatic Relations
The Republic of Lithuania recognized Montenegro's independence on 22th of June 2006, while diplomatic relations were established on 18th of July 2006.
The Embassy of Montenegro in the Republic of Poland, based in Warsaw, is in charge for diplomatic relations with the Republic of Lithuania. Until appointment of the new ambassador, the Embassy of Montenegro is represented by charge d'affairs a.i.
Ambassador the Republic of Lithuania, based in Budapest, is H.E. Mr. Eduardas Borisovas.
